items.ti: 우리 아름다운 반사 연못의 수치스러운 파괴 행위와 관련하여 많은 추가 사람들이 체포되었습니다. 1922년 처음 지어진 이래로 이런 모습도, 작동한 적도 없는데, 그때도 심하게 누수되어 작동하지 않았습니다. 우리 제품은 거울 같은 마감을 포함하여 완벽하게 작동했으며, 이전에는 없었던 두 개의 위대한 기념물을 완벽하게 반영했습니다! 이 끔찍한 파괴자들이 저지른 일은 조지 워싱턴 대통령과 에이브러햄 링컨 대통령 모두에 대한 진정한 모욕이며 그에 따라 처리되어야 합니다. 오늘 우리는 계약자들을 만났는데 아마도 필요한 수리를 하기 위해 많은 양의 물을 방류하고 배수해야 할 것이지만 가능한 한 빨리 완료하도록 할 것입니다. 그들이 피해를 입힌 것에는 이전에 가장 적은 양의 풀을 죽인 것조차 포함되지 않습니다. 그들은 어떤 형태의 칼이나 칼날을 가져다가 250피트 길이의
items.ti_en: Many additional people have been arrested having to do with the disgraceful Vandalism of our beautiful Reflecting Pool. It hasn’t looked or worked like this since 1922, when it was originally built, but even then, it leaked badly, and didn’t work. Ours worked perfectly, including the mirror like finish, perfectly reflecting the two Great Monuments, which it never had before! What these terrible Vandals have done is a true affront to both Presidents George Washington and Abraham Lincoln, and should be dealt with accordingly. We met with contractors today, will probably be forced to release and drain much of the water in order to do the necessary repairs, but will have them done as quickly as possible. What they have damaged does not even include the earlier killing of a large amount of grass which was, by far, the least of it. They took some form of knife or blade, and put a 250 foot long gash into the beautiful facade of what took so much work, competence, and money to build and complete. They also poured corrosive and destructive chemicals into the Pool. The Reflecting Pool was never so beautiful as it was just one week ago, even going back to 1922 when it opened. We are very proud of what we have done with this magnificent structure, and we will get it repaired, quickly, to an equal level of Beauty. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 설문 조사: ICE는 가짜 뉴스 미디어에 의해 이전에는 볼 수 없었던 수준으로 학대를 받았습니다. 그들은 매우 적대적인 환경에서 열심히 일하고 환상적인 일을 해내는 위대한 애국자들입니다. 이러한 적대감의 대부분은 민주당원과 가짜 뉴스에 의해 발생합니다. 내가 꽤 오랫동안 갖고 있던 개념 - 이 애국자들의 이름인 "ICE"를 "NICE"로 바꿔야 한다는 강한 느낌. 비뚤어진, 부정직하고 비애국적인 기자와 언론인들을 완전히 혼란스럽게 할 것이라는 점에서. "ICE"가 아니라 "우리 오늘 NICE 시설에 갔어요"라든가 "NICE 요원들이 폭력 마약상을 추방했습니다"라고 말하면 도저히 감당할 수가 없고 완전 미쳐버릴 거예요! 이것이 의미하는 것은 "ICE("Immigration and Customs Enforcement")에 "N"("National")을 추가하는 것입니다 — 훨씬 더 유명한 이름입니다. 모두가 그것을 좋아하지만 전설적인 Tom Homan은 요원들이 그것을 O만큼 좋아하지 않는다고 들었습니다.
items.ti_en: POLL: ICE has been abused by the Fake News Media at levels never seen before. They are Great Patriots who work hard, and do a fantastic job in a very hostile environment. Much of this hostility is caused by the Dumocrats and the Fake News. The concept I have had for quite some time — A strong feeling that the name of these Patriots, “ICE,” should be changed to, “NICE,” in that it will totally discombobulate Crooked, Dishonest, and Unpatriotic Reporters and Journalists. For them to say, “We went to a NICE Facility today,” as opposed to “ICE” or, “NICE Agents have deported a Violent Drug Dealer,” they won’t be able to handle it, they will go totally crazy! All it means is adding an “N” (“National”) to “ICE (“Immigration and Customs Enforcement”) — A much more prestigious name. Everyone loves it, but I have been told by the legendary Tom Homan that the Agents do not love it as much as the other population. Who thinks that we should add an “N” to change the name of “ICE” to “NICE?” Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DJT

items.ti_en: POLL: Which do you prefer, Dumocrat or Dumbocrat? In one case, you simply exchange the “e” for “u,” so simple and precise (Many people don’t know, or assume, that DUMB ends in “b”). In the other case, you spell out DUMB, but it seems to lose some of the identity to Democrats when done this way. Which is better?Thank you for your attention to this very important matter! President DJT
